definition.complete_rule: A weekday session is COMPLETE only when the acquisition window covers [start, end), no blocking gap intersects the session, bid/ask on returned bars is valid, and every returned bar has a fresh side-aware GBP quote. A source omission of at most 60 minutes is quarantined and does not by itself reject the session.
definition.dst: America/New_York rules. 17:00 is 21:00 UTC in EDT and 22:00 UTC in EST.
definition.partial_rule: The first and last sessions are PARTIAL_BOUNDARY when the download does not cover them.
